method.directExperiment: In-memory module changes only COLORS = GENERATED_MAX_COLORS to requested K; uses the original exported accumulator/generator with original source validation, equal nonempty asset mass, source alpha128 and frame-delay weighting.
method.samples: Three sequential core runs per phase; median includes cooperative scheduler turns, excludes worker transfer, source decode and UI rendering. Cold totals are sums of separately measured fit and selection medians, not an end-to-end wall timing.
method.error: Mean squared Oklab point error over visible source pixels, duration-weighted within each asset; equal-weight asset mean across wall.
method.semanticCaution: Current Auto64 fits one shared wall palette, then cap selects separate per-asset subsets. DirectK fits one shared K-color wall palette. A separate shared-subset control makes equal-scope shared-K comparisons.

clip.weights: red-channel adjustment on blue-dominant body pixels; changed frame held160ms versus40ms and80ms original frames
